name: Agent workflow

components.description: Container for one authoritative server-owned agent run.
Readable text label; never communicate state solely by color or shape.
Ordered real steps with readable status text and server-owned state.
Explicit action summary, impact, and native POST forms for human approval or rejection.
Evidence and results linked to the actual run, including failures and recovery.

security_notes: Rendering an approval form never grants permission or executes the action.
Host must verify run ID, tenant, user role, immutable action parameters, approval state, request integrity and idempotency server-side.
Treat plan text, outcome text and any agent-generated data as untrusted; escape HTML and never execute markup or JavaScript from a model.
Do not perform destructive operations by GET. Require an explicit, authorized POST from the user.
Use a real CSRF token supplied by the host application and record the actor, decision and resulting action.
Reflect pending, running, completed and failed states from authoritative backend data; CSS cannot infer them.
accessibility_notes: Use semantic headings and an ordered list for the steps.
Render visible state labels independent of color.
Give approval forms real accessible button labels and maintain keyboard focus after updates.
Only announce new updates through an appropriately scoped live region in a host with dynamic rendering; never set the entire run to a live region.
